texts: Render Lab turns a framed, posed avatar into the call that makes it. Pick the avatar, scene and pose in the browser, and the code panel writes the same render as a curl command, a live web component or an MCP tool call. Every control on the page maps to one parameter of GET /api/avatar/render, so what you see is what the call returns.
The MCP version calls render_avatar_image with the avatar, scene, size and pose, for Claude, Cursor or any MCP client. Try it at three.ws/render-lab.
